title: Networking and ideas
author: PoggiSlice
selftext: I'm honestly looking to make friends within the same interests. I have a steady friend group and work in semiconductor, but I do not have friends that share the same interests of coding and trading. I'm not looking to join a big group,discords, whatsapps or anything like that. Just a few people to chat with and share ideas and struggles that I've encountered.

comments.author: Fynca
comments.body: I get that. A small circle where people can share unfinished ideas, failed tests, and real problems is often more useful than a huge group full of signals. I work around market research, AI, and product development, so there’s a lot of overlap. Happy to connect and compare notes. What are you currently building, and do you mainly trade semiconductors or other markets?

replies.author: PoggiSlice
replies.body: Currently working on a few forex strategy builds and a futures builds. I do not trade any semiconductor or equities. I want to keep my focus on mainly futures, forex and eventually crypto added. I build a few backtest and went through a very rigorous trial and error with that. I'll shoot you a dm.

replies.author: waynejerome
replies.body: What are you currently building would you be open to go into specifics and exchange notes? I have quite a few proper AI native trading strategies! (That I'm sure you'd absolutely love) 🤫

comments.author: waynejerome
comments.body:
Heyy Poggi, I think I find myself in the same pot, I'd really want to network but like you said, I'd prefer a tight knit circle as opposed to a generic group with 1000+ inactive members! 

I take great joy in coding, I've been doing it for 9+ years now, algorithmic trading is also my jig! 

I'd be happy to connect!
